periods.label: Thu 5 Nov
periods.text: South to southwesterly 20 to 30 knots. 2 to 3 metres. Southerly 1 to 2 metres, increasing to 2.5 to 3 metres during the afternoon. Partly cloudy.

periods.label: Fri 6 Nov
periods.text: Southerly 15 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots offshore early in the morning. Winds becoming variable about 10 knots in the morning then becoming northeasterly 15 to 20 knots in the middle of the day. 2 to 3 metres, decreasing to 1 metre during the morning. Southerly 1 to 2 metres inshore, increasing to 2 to 3 metres offshore. Sunny.

periods.label: Sat 7 Nov
periods.text: North to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots shifting south to southwesterly 20 to 30 knots during the morning. 1 to 2 metres, increasing to 2.5 to 3 metres during the afternoon or evening. Southerly 1 to 1.5 metres inshore, increasing to 1.5 to 2 metres offshore during the afternoon. Becoming cloudy. 95% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the afternoon and evening.

periods.label: Thu 5 Nov
periods.text: Northwesterly 15 to 25 knots shifting southeasterly in the afternoon. Winds reaching up to 30 knots offshore north of Yamba in the evening. Squalls possible with the wind change. Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the afternoon. East to northeasterly below 1 metre. Sunny.

periods.label: Fri 6 Nov
periods.text: South to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots, reaching up to 20 knots offshore north of Yamba early in the morning. Winds turning east to northeasterly in the late afternoon. 1 to 2 metres, decreasing below 1 metre during the morning. Southerly 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the morning. Mostly sunny.

periods.label: Sat 7 Nov
periods.text: Northeasterly about 10 knots tending northerly 10 to 15 knots during the morning then increasing to 15 to 25 knots during the day. Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the afternoon. Southerly 1 to 2 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning. Mostly sunny day. The chance of a thunderstorm in the evening.

periods.label: Thu 5 Nov
periods.text: Southerly 15 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots south of Coffs Harbour in the late afternoon. 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1.5 to 2 metres during the afternoon. Southerly around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres by early evening. Sunny.

periods.label: Fri 6 Nov
periods.text: South to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots shifting east to northeasterly in the late afternoon. 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing below 1 metre during the morning. Southerly 2 to 2.5 metres. Mostly sunny.

periods.label: Sat 7 Nov
periods.text: Northerly 15 to 20 knots increasing to 20 to 25 knots during the evening. Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres offshore during the morning. Southerly 1 to 2 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning. Sunny day. The chance of a thunderstorm in the afternoon and evening.

periods.label: Thu 5 Nov
periods.text: Southwesterly 20 to 30 knots. 2 to 3 metres. Southwesterly 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1.5 to 2.5 metres around midday, then tending south to southwesterly 1 to 2 metres by early evening. Partly cloudy. 60% chance of showers.

periods.label: Fri 6 Nov
periods.text: Southwesterly 15 to 20 knots, reaching up to 30 knots offshore early in the morning. Winds shifting east to northeasterly below 10 knots in the early afternoon. 2 to 3 metres, decreasing to 1 metre during the morning. Southerly 1 to 1.5 metres inshore, increasing to 1 to 2 metres offshore north of Merimbula. Sunny.

periods.label: Sat 7 Nov

South to southwesterly around 1 metre inshore, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres offshore. Partly cloudy. 90% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the afternoon and evening.

periods.label: Thu 5 Nov
periods.text: Southwesterly 20 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots in the late morning and early afternoon. Winds turning southerly in the afternoon. 1.5 to 2.5 metres. Below 0.5 metres, tending southerly 1 to 1.5 metres around midday. Mostly sunny.

periods.label: Fri 6 Nov
periods.text: Southerly 15 to 20 knots, reaching up to 25 knots offshore south of Port Stephens early in the morning. Winds shifting northeasterly in the evening. 1 to 2 metres, decreasing to 1 metre during the morning. Southerly 1.5 to 2.5 metres. Mostly sunny.

periods.label: Sat 7 Nov
periods.text: Northwest to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots tending northeast to southeasterly during the afternoon then tending south to southwesterly 20 to 30 knots during the evening. 1 to 1.5 metres. Southerly 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning. Mostly sunny. 90% chance of showers. A thunderstorm likely in the afternoon and evening.

periods.label: Thu 5 Nov
periods.text: Southwesterly 20 to 30 knots turning southerly in the afternoon. 1.5 to 2 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres offshore south of Port Kembla. Southerly 1.5 to 2 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the afternoon. Partly cloudy.

periods.label: Fri 6 Nov
periods.text: Southerly 15 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots offshore south of Port Kembla early in the morning. Winds tending south to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots in the early morning then shifting north to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots during the day. 1.5 to 2.5 metres, decreasing to 1 metre during the morning, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres inshore during the afternoon. Southerly 2.5 to 3 metres, decreasing to 1.5 to 2 metres around midday. Mostly sunny.
